name: Deep-level transient spectroscopy of nitrogen-containing float-zone silicon Schottky diodes,36–300 K
plain_name: Measure semiconductor defect traps through capacitance transients
description: Measure semiconductor defect traps through capacitance transients. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Scheffler et al. (2023), Comparison of the Properties of Defect States in Nitrogen-Containing n- and p-Type Float-Zone Silicon: A Combined Deep-Level Transient Spectroscopy and Minority-Carrier Transient Spectroscopy Study

requirements.rationale: Replicate the published DLTS temperature scan. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

A capacitance bridge/meter and trap-filling transient measurement electronics are essential; electrical probe arms alone do not supply DLTS. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: Trap-filling/reverse bias, rate window, excitation pulse widths, diode contact quality and leakage must be reviewed; no defect activation energy is predicted.
The source's separate80–310 K optically excited MCTS apparatus is not merged into this DLTS profile.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
